helpModal.title: VRMNailAttacher User Guide
helpModal.lead: VRMNailAttacher is a web tool to automatically attach 3D nail chips to VRM avatars, align them precisely, and customize textures.
helpModal.step1Desc: Click 'Open Local VRM' or drag & drop a VRM model. You can also pick a preset model to get started immediately.
helpModal.step2Desc: Click 'Auto-Attach Nails' to detect all 10 fingertip bones and attach nail chips with optimal orientation.
helpModal.step3Desc: Use the 'Fingertip' camera button on the bottom bar to focus closely on the active finger. Switching to 'Open Hands' pose makes editing much easier.
helpModal.step4Desc: Adjust overall scale with 'Global Scale', then select individual fingers to position them perfectly.
helpModal.step5Desc: Pick from presets like Cheek, French, or Baby Boomer, or drop your own image to apply custom nail art.
helpModal.badgeFingertipDesc: Instantly zooms in to the active fingertip. Automatically follows finger switching.
helpModal.badgeHandsDesc: Views both hands from a comfortable distance.
helpModal.badgeTopAngleDesc: Check nail thickness and cuticle alignment directly from above or at an angle.
helpModal.badgePoseDesc: Straightens fingers into an open pose for effortless nail alignment.
helpModal.globalScaleDesc1: Different avatars have different hand sizes. Use the overall scale slider (0.5x–2.0x) or -0.01 / +0.01 step buttons for quick scaling.
helpModal.globalScaleDesc2: Detailed Ratios: Click 'Expand Ratio Details' to independently adjust Length, Width, and Thickness.
helpModal.fingerFittingDesc: Select a finger (Thumb, Index, Middle, Ring, Little) and adjust position (X/Y/Z) or angle (Pitch/Yaw/Roll) sliders to match the cuticle line.
helpModal.symmetryDesc: When Symmetrical Mirroring is checked, changes on the left hand are mirrored to the right hand automatically.
helpModal.scopeDesc: Unified design across all fingers merges textures into a single material for optimal performance and high quality.
helpModal.uploadHelpDesc: Drag & drop any PNG, JPEG, or WebP image into the upload box to immediately see it on your avatar's nails. Uploaded images are stored in 'My Textures'.
helpModal.templateDownloadDesc: Download official templates to create your own nail textures:
helpModal.templateListBase: Base Texture (PNG): Plain reference texture for drawing
helpModal.templateNote: Open in Photoshop, CLIP STUDIO PAINT, Procreate, or ibisPaint, paint your designs, and export as PNG to upload.
